Description
The Valcambi CombiBar™ is a unique and innovative way to invest in gold. Each
20 gram Valcambi gold
CombiBar™ contains 20 individual 1 gram gold bars, each of which can be easily separated from the others. This makes
20
gram Valcambi combibar
an ideal investment for those who want the flexibility of owning smaller denominations of gold without having to purchase multiple individual bars.
The 20 x 1 gram Gold Valcambi CombiBar™ (In Assay) is a highly sought-after investment product. It is produced by Valcambi, one of the world’s leading precious metals refineries. Each gold Valcambi CombiBar™ is made from 999.9 fine gold and is encased in an assay card to guarantee its authenticity and purity.
Design of 20 x 1 gram Gold Valcambi CombiBar™ (In Assay)
The Valcambi monogram, weight, and purity of each 1
gram gold bar
are featured on the front of the Valcambi
combibar
. The combibar for sale is combined to make a 20-gram gold Valcambi bar with the CombiBar feature. The CombiBar technology makes it easy for the investor to resell or store the bar by breaking it even from a breakpoint so that it is intact and doesn’t lose its metals or form. The reverse of the bar lists its purity, mint, and weight. The assay card specifies the authentication details and weight of the bar, assuring the customer of its authenticity.
In addition to its practicality, the Valcambi CombiBar™ is also a beautiful and well-crafted piece of art. Each 20 gram Valcambi combibar has a unique design on its reverse side, adding to its overall aesthetic appeal.
